_meta.description: Per-row hat-matrix leverage h_ii on customers.pulse with target=income and predictors=[age] via ATTR_REG_LEVERAGE. Leverage measures each row's structural influence on the OLS fit independently of the residual; sum(h_ii) = p + 1 (the predictor count plus the intercept). High-leverage rows (h_ii close to 1) are candidates for the influence-investigation column in a model-quality dashboard. Penalty is rejected by the leverage builder — the hat matrix is only defined for unpenalised OLS.
_meta.name: attr_reg_leverage
